title: A loaded session shows the summary of each question form it answered
body:
coax-b71e9f added `Entry::Answers`, which `App::answer` in `src/app.rs` builds from the open `Form` when the person answers or dismisses an agent's question form. The entry exists only in a live session. A session opened again with `session/load` replays the `AskUserQuestion` call as an ordinary tool call, and coax has no `Form` to build the summary from.

## Proposal

- When a replayed `AskUserQuestion` tool call carries the questions in `rawInput` and the answers in its result, coax builds the same `Entry::Answers` from them and places it after the call.

## Open

- What the Claude adapter v0.101.0 replays for an `AskUserQuestion` call: whether `rawInput` holds the questions, and whether the result text holds the answers in a form coax can read.
